info.title: Magic Eden EVM API
info.description: You are viewing the reference docs for the MagicEden EVM API.

post.description: Use this API to explore a collection's metadata and statistics (sales, volume, etc).

collectionIds.description: List of collection IDs to retrieve. example: `0xbd3531da5cf5857e7cfaa92426877b022e612cf8`

collectionSlugs.description: List of collection Slugs to retrieve. example: `pudgypenguins`

post.description: Use this API to do a fuzzy collection search

pattern.description: Any name pattern you want to search for collections. Only first 50 collection matched will be returned

post.description: Use this API to explore a user's collections metadata and statistics (sales, volume, etc).

walletAddresses.description: a list of user wallet address to query collection stats from. example: `0x47d88afbba889709abba07339ed1c88079944ca3`

get.description: Use this API to explore a collection's assets and its market info

parameters.name: collectionId
parameters.description: The collection id to query assets. example: `0xbd3531da5cf5857e7cfaa92426877b022e612cf8`

parameters.name: assetIds[]
parameters.description: Filter assets by ids. example: `0xbd3531da5cf5857e7cfaa92426877b022e612cf8:0`

parameters.name: includeFloorAskSource[]
parameters.description: Filter assets whose floor ask is from specific sources. if `any` is specified, means return assets which are listed only

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: Filter assets by its name

parameters.name: includeTopBid
parameters.description: Whether to include top bid for returned assets, default to __false__

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Amount of items returned, default to __20__

parameters.name: continuation
parameters.description: Use continuation token to request next offset of assets.

continuation.description: used to get next offset of items

get.description: Use this API to explore a user's assets and its market info

parameters.name: walletAddresses[]
parameters.description: The wallet address (user address) to query assets from, could be a list, example: `0x47d88afbba889709abba07339ed1c88079944ca3`

parameters.name: assetIds[]
parameters.description: Filter assets by ids. example: `0xbd3531da5cf5857e7cfaa92426877b022e612cf8:0`

parameters.name: collectionIds[]
parameters.description: Filter assets by collectionIds. example: `0xbd3531da5cf5857e7cfaa92426877b022e612cf8`

parameters.name: onlyListed
parameters.description: Whether to show only listed assets, default to __false__

parameters.name: includeTopBid
parameters.description: Whether to include top bid for returned assets, default to __false__

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Amount of items returned, default to __20__

parameters.name: continuation
parameters.description: Use continuation token to request next offset of assets.

continuation.description: used to get next offset of items

get.description: Use this API to search asks

parameters.name: ids[]
parameters.description: Direct fetch asks by ids, other filters will be ignored if `ids` is provided. Either `ids` and `collectionId` must be provided

parameters.name: collectionId
parameters.description: Filter by collectionId. example: `0xbd3531da5cf5857e7cfaa92426877b022e612cf8`. Either `ids` and `collectionId` must be provided

parameters.name: assetIds[]
parameters.description: Filter by asset ids. example: `0xbd3531da5cf5857e7cfaa92426877b022e612cf8:0`

parameters.name: makers[]
parameters.description: Filter by makers who made these asks. example: `0x47d88afbba889709abba07339ed1c88079944ca3`

parameters.name: sources[]
parameters.description: Filter by order source.

parameters.name: status[]
parameters.description: Filter by order status. default `active`

parameters.name: createAfter
parameters.description: Filter orders after some create timestamp using UTC format. example: `2025-05-01T06:01:09.000Z`.

parameters.name: updateAfter
parameters.description: Filter orders after some update timestamp using UTC format. example: `2025-05-01T06:01:09.000Z`.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Amount of items returned, default to __20__

parameters.name: continuation
parameters.description: Use continuation token to request next offset of items.

continuation.description: used to get next offset of items

get.description: Use this API to search bids

parameters.name: ids[]
parameters.description: Direct fetch bids by ids, other filters will be ignored if `ids` is provided. Either `ids` and `bidTypes[] + collectionId` must be provided

parameters.name: bidTypes[]
parameters.description: Filter by bid types

parameters.name: collectionId
parameters.description: Filter by collectionId. example: `0xbd3531da5cf5857e7cfaa92426877b022e612cf8`. Either `ids` and `collectionId` must be provided

parameters.name: assetIds[]
parameters.description: Filter by asset ids. example: `0xbd3531da5cf5857e7cfaa92426877b022e612cf8:0`

parameters.name: attributes[]
parameters.description: Filter by attributes, could be a list, format as `<attribute_name>:<attribute_value>`, example: `Background:Black`

parameters.name: makers[]
parameters.description: Filter by makers who made these bids. example: `0x47d88afbba889709abba07339ed1c88079944ca3`

parameters.name: sources[]
parameters.description: Filter by order source.

parameters.name: status[]
parameters.description: Filter by order status. default `active`

parameters.name: createAfter
parameters.description: Filter orders after some create timestamp using UTC format. example: `2025-05-01T06:01:09.000Z`.

parameters.name: updateAfter
parameters.description: Filter orders after some update timestamp using UTC format. example: `2025-05-01T06:01:09.000Z`.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Amount of items returned, default to __20__

parameters.name: continuation
parameters.description: Use continuation token to request next offset of items.

continuation.description: used to get next offset of items

get.description: Use this API to get NFT activity

parameters.name: activityTypes[]
parameters.description: The activity types to query

parameters.name: fromTime
parameters.description: `From time` of time range to query

parameters.name: toTime
parameters.description: `To time` of time range to query

parameters.name: assetId
parameters.description: Asset Id to filter for activities. Either `assetId` or `collectionId` or `walletAddress` should be provided. example: `0xbd3531da5cf5857e7cfaa92426877b022e612cf8:0`

parameters.name: collectionId
parameters.description: Collection Id to filter for activities. Either `assetId` or `collectionId` or `walletAddress` should be provided. example: `0xbd3531da5cf5857e7cfaa92426877b022e612cf8`

parameters.name: walletAddress
parameters.description: User wallet address to filter for activities. Either `assetId` or `collectionId` or `walletAddress` should be provided. example: `0x47d88afbba889709abba07339ed1c88079944ca3`

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Amount of items returned, default to __20__

parameters.name: continuation
parameters.description: Use continuation token to request next offset of items.

continuation.description: used to get next offset of items

post.description: Generate listings for assets (tokens). This API is used to generate listing data to sign. Once you get signing data from this API, you shall sign them and post to another listing creation API to finish listing generation

maker.description: listing maker, should be owner of these assets(tokens) that wish to be listed.

assetId.description: Asset id for listing, could be a ERC-721 or ERC-1155

quantity.description: Asset quantity to list, for ERC-721, must specified 1, for ERC-1155, could be > 1

raw.description: price with on-chain currency in its decimal format. e.g. `0x0000000000000000000000000000000000000000` stands for ETH in ethereum, so to specify 1 ETH (deicmals == 18), you should input `1000000000000000000`

royaltyBps.description: Royalty bps to paid to creator for listing if there are

expirationInSeconds.description: Expiration time (in seconds). Min: 15 minutes, Max: 1 year

contractApprovalsNeeded.description: Contract approvals needed to be signed before listing. This is for delegating MagicEden to move user's assets when listings are fulfilled

from.description: Transaction issuer: from whom sends this transaction

to.description: Transaction destination: to where this transaction shall be executed, usually a EVM smart contract address

data.description: Hex-ed transaction data to sign before broadcasting to EVM network

value.description: Transaction value to specifiy when broadcasting to EVM network

listingDataToSign.description: Standard EIP-712 signature data for signing and generate signature, once signature is generated, signer usually should pass signature along with `postBody` to another API endpoint

postBody.description: Base64 encoded data that need to be pass to creation API endpoint

dataToSignAndPostList.description: Array of listing data to sign and post to listing creation API endpoint, you should call listing creation API endpoint for every item in this list with signed signature and post body
